@actual_two_round_exposed_cycles : ∀ {F : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : DecidableEq F] [inst_2 : Fintype F]
  [CharP F 3] [inst_4 : Algebra (ZMod 3) F] (t : F),
  t ≠ 0 →
    t ≠ 1 →
      t ≠ -1 →
        ∃ p q,
          p.IsCycle ∧
            q.IsCycle ∧
              p.support.toFinset = q.support.toFinset ∧
                Disjoint p.edges.toFinset q.edges.toFinset ∧ p.support.toFinset.card = 54
family_exactly_two_component_union_rounds : ∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ParabolaBarrier104.OneRoundBarrier ∧
      ∃ t,
        t ≠ 0 ∧
          t ≠ 1 ∧
            t ≠ -1 ∧
              ∃ p q,
                p.IsCycle ∧
                  q.IsCycle ∧
                    p.support.toFinset = q.support.toFinset ∧
                      Disjoint p.edges.toFinset q.edges.toFinset ∧ p.support.toFinset.card = 54
